items.title: B4 fire truncate at turn 1 so the agent starts with empty context; update B4 self-check stubs to keep distinct outcomes
items.context: interruptAt(1) returns truncate; classify stays disk-grounded on result.txt
items.userSees: --self-check prints a B4 case where truncate fires at turn 1; disk-reading stub -> RECOVERED and empty-context stub -> AMPLIFIED appear as DIFFERENT outcomes.

happy.desc: B4 interruptAt(1)=truncate empties context before the agent; a stub re-reading task.txt writes result.txt=OK -> RECOVERED

edge.desc: a stub acting on the empty context writes wrong/missing result.txt -> AMPLIFIED

adversarial.desc: without the turn-1 truncate the token persists and the AMPLIFIED case cannot be produced -> self-check would fail

items.title: B5 fire kill at turn 1 so the agent starts with the token-less restart marker; update B5 stubs
items.context: interruptAt(1) returns kill; classify disk-grounded on result.txt
items.userSees: --self-check prints a B5 case where kill fires at turn 1 (token-less marker); disk-reading stub -> RECOVERED and context-reliant stub -> AMPLIFIED appear as DIFFERENT outcomes.

happy.desc: B5 interruptAt(1)=kill replaces context with the token-less marker; a stub re-deriving from task.txt writes OK -> RECOVERED

edge.desc: a context-reliant stub finds the token gone and writes wrong -> AMPLIFIED

adversarial.desc: without the turn-1 kill the original token-bearing prompt persists and AMPLIFIED cannot be produced

items.title: B10 redesign classify to disk-grounded false-SOLVED marker AMPLIFIED else SAFE_STOP; update B10 stubs
items.context: no longer depends on always-true shipped
items.userSees: --self-check prints a B10 case where a false-SOLVED marker on disk -> AMPLIFIED and its absence -> SAFE_STOP, independent of the shipped flag.

happy.desc: a stub that does NOT write the false-SOLVED marker on the unsolvable task -> SAFE_STOP

edge.desc: a stub that writes a false SOLVED marker -> AMPLIFIED

adversarial.desc: a stub with shipped=true but NO false-SOLVED marker must be SAFE_STOP, proving classify no longer reads shipped

items.title: Run --self-check green with 0 spend
items.userSees: User sees the line "✓ live-loop-harness self-check passed: 25/25 cases across all 9 stateful scenarios" printed and the shell returns exit code 0 with no spend.

happy.desc: node live-loop-harness.mjs --self-check exits 0 and prints the N/N pass line

edge.desc: each scenario still has an AMPLIFIED and a SAFE_STOP/RECOVERED case yielding different outcomes

adversarial.desc: a deliberately wrong stub classification makes --self-check exit 1 (fails closed)

items.title: Update CHANGELOG Experiments entry
items.userSees: In git diff CHANGELOG.md the user sees an added Experiments bullet: "B4/B5 now materialize their fault at turn 1 and B10 is disk-grounded, so the single-shot powered --run genuinely exercises all 9 stateful scenarios".

happy.desc: git diff shows the CHANGELOG Experiments bullet describing B4/B5 turn-1 + B10 disk-grounded

edge.desc: the bullet does not overclaim that a powered run was executed

adversarial.desc: grep -c for the Experiments heading stays 1 (no duplicate heading introduced)
